name: Faduun
description: Immense granite head sculptures with glowing mouths, crafted by an ancient cabal of human mages as guardians of a secret stronghold; pre-Eldrazi.

description_citations.text: "Jwar Isle". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The party sails to Jwar Isle, tormented by suspicions of Anowon, and hears the faduun.
timeline.quote: Behind him, he could hear a dark, gravelly voice grumble in a tongue unknown to him.

citation.text: "Hunger" by Brandon O'Brien. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Sep 2020.

relations.quote: Scattered across Jwar Isle are dozens of immense granite sculptures called faduun .

citation.text: "Jwar Isle", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

pages_say.description: Stone faces with glowing jaws on Jwar Isle that seem to whisper in an unknown tongue.
